text:
james: ran a quick nsys capture on the regressed latency case, attaching notes here
priya: thanks — what workload + config? batching heuristics change from last week?
james: small sequence generative workload, previously used small-batch fast-path. after the heuristic tweak we see kernel-switch to the large-batch kernel at ~480 tokens, weird crossover point.
alex: can you paste timeline snippet? are we seeing big H2D spikes?
james: yep — nsys timeline shows a concentrated H2D transfer right before the large attention kernel launches. bandwidth saturates for ~12ms, then kernel stalls waiting for data.
maya: kv-cache miss pattern? could be prefetch not firing when batch size jumps kernel type.
james: exactly. kvcache eviction + batching leads to bursty host->device peercopy. when a few shards miss, the runtime falls back to pageable peercopy and we get serialization.
perf-bot: automated note: detected 3x increase in H2D transfer time vs baseline for trace 1765432100, flagged possible pageable stall.
priya: do we have pinned vs pageable breakdown?
james: yes — nvprof/KPIs: pinned transfers ~600 MB/s, pageable path drops to ~120 MB/s here. the runtime currently chooses pageable if buffer isn't pre-pinned during kernel switch.
alex: can we push a pre-pin at the batching boundary? maybe add a small prefetch thread to pin hot KV pages before large-batch kernel selection.
maya: also worth adding a micro-benchmark: rapid small misses followed by a large request to reproduce. I can craft an nsys script with per-stream markers.
james: pasted minimal repro snippet in the thread:
```
# repro loop: trigger KV miss then large batch
for i in range(8):
  request.small()  # populates eviction pattern
# then single large request
request.large(tokens=600)
```
priya: run with --capture-range and trace the memcpy kind column, capture CPU pinned allocation calls too.
perf-bot: tip: set NVTX ranges around prefetch and kernel selection code to correlate host allocations with subsequent memcpy.
alex: if pre-pinning fixes it, we should change batching heuristic to delay kernel type flip until pre-pin completes or mark transition as atomic.
maya: agreed. also need a fallback: if pageable path used, throttle kernel launch to allow asynchronous staging to finish (or fall back to smaller kernel that tolerates pageable).
james: next steps: maya will add nsys repro with NVTX and capture pinned allocs; alex will prototype a pre-pin hook; priya will add a metric that counts kernel-type flips per request and H2D spike correlation. i'll collate traces and upload to S3.
priya: timeline: aim for PoC by EOD tomorrow.
maya: adding notes to the perf board. :+1:
james: thanks all, i'll post the capture link when uploaded.
